description:
Return a temporary download URL for an inbound email's original MIME source.

        The URL expires after approximately five minutes and requires no authorization header.
        Raw source is available only for inbound emails.
        Returns ``url``, or an error for an unavailable email.

email_id.description: Inbound email ID, from ``list_emails`` with direction ``inbound``.
email_id.title: Email Id

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: get_email_raw
title: Get raw email
